card.name: Acute or emergency before a condition term
card.fires_on: The words acute and emergency (also single, burst) when they describe short-term use or sudden need, such as acute symptoms, emergency contraception or acute pain. It also fires inside the word acute when it is split.

modes.label: Acute symptoms
modes.description: The word acute, or its first part, before symptoms, pain, prevention or treatment.
modes.example: TRELEGY ELLIPTA should not be used for the relief of<< acute>> symptoms, i.e., as rescue therapy

modes.label: Emergency contraception
modes.example: For use as post-coital contraception (<<emergency>> contraception)

modes.label: Other short-term wording
modes.description: Words like single or burst that describe a brief, one-off event.

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning temporary, instant or short-term.
card.plain: It marks words that say something is short-term or sudden, like acute or emergency.
